# Hotel Jangid Gogamedi

> Hotel Jangid is the premier budget luxury hotel in Gogamedi (Gugamedi), Rajasthan, located just 400 meters from Shri Goga Ji Maharaj Temple and 900 meters from Gogamedi Railway Station. We offer 23 clean Deluxe AC (₹1,200/night) and Non-AC (₹1,000/night) rooms with 24/7 hot water geysers, free private parking, and high-speed Wi-Fi.

## Key Information
- **Business Name**: Hotel Jangid (Hotel Jangid Gogamedi)
- **Category**: Hotel, Budget Luxury Lodging, Pilgrimage Guest House
- **Address**: Near Shri Goga Ji Maharaj Temple, Railway Station Road, Gogamedi, Hanumangarh, Rajasthan - 335504, India
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +91 90011 87776
- **Email**: hoteljangidgogamedi@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://hoteljangid.in/
- **Google Maps**: https://maps.google.com/?q=29.0205,75.2016
- **Check-in / Check-out**: 12:00 PM Check-in / 11:00 AM Check-out (Flexible 24-hour reception)

## Leadership & Team
- **Surjeet Jangid**: Founder & Elder. Oversees family hospitality tradition, welcoming pilgrims and families to Gogamedi Dham for over two decades.
- **Vijay Jangid**: Co-Owner & General Manager. Personally on-site daily managing guest hospitality, room cleanliness, bookings, and temple darshan guidance. Contact: +91 90011 87776.

## Accommodations & Tariffs
- [Deluxe AC Room](https://hoteljangid.in/#rooms): ₹1,200 per night. High-cooling split AC, double bed, extra cot, attached western bathroom with 24/7 geyser, LED TV, 100% inverter power backup.
- [Standard Non-AC Room](https://hoteljangid.in/#rooms): ₹1,000 per night. Heavy-duty desert air cooler, ceiling fan, comfortable double bed, attached private bathroom with geyser, airy windows.

## Core Amenities
- [Hotel Amenities](https://hoteljangid.in/#amenities): 24/7 hot water geyser, free private gated vehicle parking (cars, SUVs, buses), 100% power backup, high-speed Wi-Fi, pure RO drinking water, daily housekeeping.
- [Temple Proximity](https://hoteljangid.in/#temple-distance): 400 meters (5-minute walk) to Shri Goga Ji Maharaj Mandir. 900 meters to Gogamedi Railway Station.
